verdict.rationale: Mangopay ships AI-oriented developer artifacts: an llms.txt with instructions for AI agents, Markdown versions of every docs page via a 'build with AI' guide, a public OpenAPI spec, and an official MCP server. These would let an AI agent translate natural-language requests into API calls. However, the MCP server sits under the docs domain (/_mcp/server), which suggests it serves documentation rather than live product operations. Nothing shows users directly issuing natural-language commands to run payments, wallets or payouts. Missing for 10: evidence that the MCP server or any assistant performs actual account and transaction operations, a first-party natural-language interface (e.g. a dashboard assistant), and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
